description: FIND-007 was only PARTIALLY remediated. The engines mismatch (part c) is FIXED — package.json:16 now declares node>=20, matching inngest@4.11.0 (node_modules/inngest/package.json:435). But parts (a) and (b) are unchanged in code: each per-user handler still wraps the ENTIRE multi-side-effect per-user body inside ONE step.run (functions.js:111 `step.run('wake', () => wakeOnce(u, Date.now()))`; 124 travel; 137 ask). Inngest memoizes at the step boundary, so a transient failure mid-body (e.g. a Telnyx/Maps error after some placeCall/patchEvent effects) causes Inngest to RETRY the whole body — replay protection rests ENTIRELY on the C-H1 atomic claims, not on Inngest's step granularity (the opposite of the durable-step pattern). Additionally Date.now() is still called INSIDE step.run (functions.js:111), so the timestamp differs across replays — non-deterministic, mildly at odds with REQ-27's determinism intent. It works (claims are atomic) but under-uses Inngest's durability guarantees.
